Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. ____________ hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 6. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:-

(a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 7. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 9. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 10. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 11. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of CCTV Surveillance System 1. OEM Authorization Certificate The bidder shall submit a valid OEM Authorization Certificate / Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) spe cifically issued for the subject bid, mentioning the bid reference number, offered make and model, and aut horization to supply, install, commission and provide warranty support for the offered CCTV equipment. 2. OEM Turnover Certificate The bidder shall submit an OEM turnover certificate for the financial years specified in the bid, duly certifie d by the OEM's authorized signatory or supported by acceptable financial documents. Any minimum turno ver threshold shall be specified in the tender and justified with reference to the project value and risk. 3. Local Service Support Facility The bidder shall provide a functioning service support facility or an authorized service partner within the d esignated service area of Bathinda, Punjab. The service arrangement must remain valid throughout the w arranty period. 4. Local Technical Support and Manpower The bidder shall have technical personnel for CCTV installation, configuration, networking, fault diagnosis,

maintenance and restoration of services. Details of the service coordinator and technical support team sha ll be submitted before execution, as required by the buyer. 5. Service Response Time The successful bidder shall provide the following service levels: - Complaint acknowledgement: Within 24 working hours. - Remote troubleshooting: Within 24–48 working hours. - On-site visit: Within 48 working hours of complaint registration, where required. The bidder shall provide a dedicated service telephone number and email address. 6. Minimum One Year Warranty All CCTV cameras, NVRs, switches, power supplies and other equipment shall carry a minimum comprehen sive warranty of two years from successful installation, commissioning and acceptance, unless a different period is prescribed for a particular item in the BOQ. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and hardware failures under normal operating conditions. Warranty repairs and replacements covered under the contract shall be provided without additional cost. 7. STQC and Applicable Certification Where required by the tender specifications or applicable government procurement directions, CCTV came ras and associated equipment shall comply with the applicable STQC certification requirements. The bidde r shall submit valid certificates corresponding to the offered make and exact model, wherever such certific ation is mandatory. 8. Technical Compliance and Datasheets The bidder shall submit an item-wise technical compliance sheet and official OEM datasheets specifying, a s applicable: 9. Genuine and New Equipment All equipment shall be brand-new, unused, genuine and sourced through authorized or legitimate supply c hannels. Refurbished, reconditioned or counterfeit products shall not be accepted. The buyer may verify s erial numbers, model numbers and warranty status with the OEM. 10. Installation and Commissioning Capability The bidder shall demonstrate the ability to undertake installation, cable laying, termination, camera config uration, NVR configuration, recording verification, network integration and handover. The installation meth odology and proposed manpower deployment shall be submitted before commencement of work, where r equired. 11. Preventive Maintenance and Service Records The successful bidder shall maintain service records, including complaint numbers, visit dates, fault details, corrective actions and closure reports. Preventive maintenance shall be carried out at the frequenc y specified in the contract. 12. OEM and Bidder Document Verification The buyer reserves the right to verify the authenticity of OEM authorization, turnover certificates, warranty documents, certification records and local service support evidence with the issuing organizations. Invalid or materially misleading documents shall be dealt with under the applicable procurement rules. 13. Make in India and MSE Preference Applicable purchase preference shall be extended to eligible Class-I local suppliers and eligible MSEs in ac cordance with the prevailing Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, Public Procurement P olicy for MSEs, applicable GeM provisions and relevant government instructions. 16. Objective Evaluation

All technical and service-support requirements shall be evaluated uniformly against the published bid cond itions. The buyer may verify the submitted documents and seek clarifications as permitted under the appli cable procurement rules. 17. Governing Conditions These ATC clauses shall be read with the BOQ, technical specifications, applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions, relevant service-level provisions and applicable government procurement policies. In the event of a conflict, the applicable rules and governing tender provisions shall prevail. . 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
